input_file.description: Path to input file; empty string means stdin

output_file.description: Path to output file; empty string means stdout

case_output.description: Case for alphabetic output characters: 'upper', 'lower', or empty for default

text_line_endings.description: Convert native text line breaks ↔ CRLF (applies only to base64* modes)

wrap_width.description: Line wrap width in characters; 0 disables all line breaks; null means use algorithm-specific default

decode_behavior.description: Decoding robustness: 'strict', 'ignore_all_space', 'ignore_garbage', or empty for default
